# Subway Seat for Warp

Background, text, accent, cursor and the 16 ANSI colors. On Linux the themes folder is `~/.local/share/warp-terminal/themes/`; on Windows, `%APPDATA%\warp\Warp\data\themes\`. Warp can take a few minutes to notice a new themes folder; restarting it is quicker.

[Warp](https://www.warp.dev) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/warp/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only warp
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp subway-seat.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat in the theme picker
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp subway-seat-tunnel.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat Tunnel in the theme picker
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp subway-seat-enamel.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat Enamel in the theme picker
```

**London Moquette**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp london-moquette.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick London Moquette in the theme picker
```

**London Deep Level**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp london-deep-level.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick London Deep Level in the theme picker
```

**London Portland**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp london-portland.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick London Portland in the theme picker
```

**Paris Guimard**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp paris-guimard.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Paris Guimard in the theme picker
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp paris-catacombes.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Paris Catacombes in the theme picker
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in a shell on macOS, then Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.warp/themes && cp paris-carrelage.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Paris Carrelage in the theme picker
```

## Follow light and dark

In Warp › Settings › Appearance:

```text
Sync with OS: on
Light: Subway Seat Enamel
Dark: Subway Seat
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.warp/themes/subway-seat.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/subway-seat-enamel.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/london-moquette.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/london-deep-level.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/london-portland.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/paris-guimard.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/paris-catacombes.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.warp/themes/paris-carrelage.yaml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
